description: The third domain problem: a summary requirement over the document pipeline, the intake operation in three personas, ordering cases around parsing and a negative case in the audit application.

required_mappings.notes: Measured: 0.9305, margin 0.3574. Fields bind exactly and the desired effect Summary.generated is shared.

negative_cases.notes: Measured: best 0.4092 (the audit policy computation, integer fields partially bind), below the 0.45 threshold. This case calibrated the threshold: weak partial matches peak around 0.41 while every intended mapping scores 0.79 or above.

full_pool_cases.notes: Against all 53 capabilities: top 1 DOC-Summarize (0.9305), runner up DOC-IndexRecord (0.5731), margin 0.3574.

compatibility_cases.notes: Parsing establishes Document.parsed and carries the page count the summary computation needs.
The page count binds, but the document identifier of the row insert binds to nothing.
Indexing updates the index table only, so the review notification precondition stays unprovable; the pair must go through parsing first.
Queuing the review request does not parse the document, so the summary cannot be proven to follow it directly.
